title: Maximize Count of Distinct Primes After Split
summary: Given an integer array nums and a series of queries, update nums at specified indices with new values.
statement: Given an integer array nums and a series of queries, update nums at specified indices with new values. For each query, split the array into two parts at a chosen index k, ensuring the sum of distinct prime counts in both parts is maximized. Return results for each query in the order they are presented.
constraints: nums and queries each contain at most 50,000 entries; values are at most 100,000.
Updates persist, and every answer maximizes over nonempty prefix-suffix splits.
A prime appearing on both sides counts once in each side.
target_time_complexity: O((n+queries) log n + V log log V)
hints: Every present prime contributes one; it contributes a second time exactly for splits after its first occurrence and at or before its last.
Maintain each prime’s extreme positions with lazy heaps and range-add its spanning split interval in a max segment tree.
Before an update remove old intervals, change position sets/heaps and distinct count, add new intervals, then return distinct+global maximum coverage.
For any split, the segment value counts precisely the primes present on both sides; adding the total distinct count equals the two side-set sizes.
editorial: For any split, the segment value counts precisely the primes present on both sides; adding the total distinct count equals the two side-set sizes.

tests.explanation: After the updates, optimal split scores are three and four.
After removing the only prime, every split scores zero.
